channel.title: Nubenetes Intelligence Digest
channel.description: AI-curated top picks from the Cloud Native & Kubernetes ecosystem

item.title: Kubecost 🌟
item.description: [CRITICAL] Kubecost is the industry standard for Kubernetes FinOps and granular multi-cluster cost allocation.

item.title: docs.anthropic.com: Claude Code CLI
item.description: [CRITICAL] Establishes a major paradigm shift toward terminal-native, autonomous agentic software engineering workflows.

item.title: antigravity.google: Google Antigravity Agentic Platform
item.description: [CRITICAL] Provides a comprehensive platform and SDK for deploying stateful, production-ready AI agents on GKE.

item.title: Crossplane
item.description: [CRITICAL] Crossplane drives a paradigm shift by transforming Kubernetes into a universal control plane for managing any cloud infrastructure.

item.title: NVIDIA/k8s-device-plugin: NVIDIA device plugin for Kubernetes
item.description: [CRITICAL] NVIDIA's device plugin is the essential foundational component enabling hardware-accelerated AI and machine learning workloads on Kubernetes.

item.title: vLLM on Kubernetes
item.description: [CRITICAL] Standardizes high-throughput, memory-efficient LLM inference and model serving natively on Kubernetes clusters.

item.title: ==dagger/dagger: Dagger is a portable devkit for CICD==
item.description: [CRITICAL] Dagger introduces a paradigm shift by replacing brittle YAML with programmable, containerized pipelines written in general-purpose languages.

item.title: github.com: Istio
item.description: [CRITICAL] Serves as the industry standard open-source service mesh control plane powering zero-trust mTLS and dynamic traffic routing.

item.title: github.com/kubernetes: **Kubernetes Cluster Autoscaler**
item.description: [CRITICAL] Cluster Autoscaler remains the foundational core component responsible for dynamically scaling infrastructure capacity based on workload demands.

item.title: github: Flux Version 2
item.description: [CRITICAL] Flux v2 provides the foundational GitOps Toolkit controllers powering enterprise-scale automated cluster state reconciliation.

item.title: github.com/prometheus/prometheus
item.description: [CRITICAL] It represents the foundational CNCF-graduated metrics collection and alerting engine powering modern cloud-native observability stacks.

item.title: containerd - An open and reliable container runtime
item.description: [CRITICAL] It is the foundational CNCF-graduated container runtime powering modern Kubernetes clusters and production container workloads.

item.title: runc
item.description: [CRITICAL] It serves as the canonical OCI reference low-level container runtime executing Linux cgroups and namespace isolation.

item.title: hashicorp/vault
item.description: [CRITICAL] HashiCorp Vault remains the enterprise industry standard for secrets management, encryption-as-a-service, and dynamic Zero Trust identity brokering across multi-cloud environments.

item.title: Cosign: Container Signing
item.description: [CRITICAL] Sigstore Cosign is the de facto standard for cryptographic signing, verification, and software supply chain integrity enforcement for OCI artifacts.

item.title: OpenTelemetry Collector
item.description: [CRITICAL] It serves as the universal, vendor-neutral standard for ingesting, transforming, and routing traces, metrics, and logs across cloud-native environments.

item.title: kube-prometheus
item.description: [CRITICAL] It provides the complete, production-ready reference architecture for deploying Prometheus, Alertmanager, and core exporters onto Kubernetes.

item.title: Kubernetes Gateway API
item.description: [CRITICAL] Defines the official next-generation specification superseding Ingress with role-oriented, expressive service routing APIs.

item.title: github.com/vmware-tanzu/velero
item.description: [CRITICAL] It serves as the de facto open-source standard for backing up, migrating, and disaster-recovering Kubernetes cluster state and persistent volumes.

item.title: trivy
item.description: [CRITICAL] Trivy serves as the ubiquitous, developer-friendly vulnerability and misconfiguration scanner spanning container images, code repositories, and IaC pipelines.
